market_question: Fed rate cut by September 2026 meeting?
reasoning: The window from December 16, 2025 through September 2026 covers 5–6 FOMC meetings. The Fed's December 2024 dot plot projected further rate cuts in 2026, and with the federal funds rate still well above neutral, further easing is a plausible base case. Market pricing of only 12.3% underestimates the likelihood of at least one cut as the economy normalizes.
evidence_points: December 2024 SEP median dot shows the federal funds rate falling from ~3.9% end‑2025 to ~3.4% end‑2026, implying 2026 cuts
The target range at the start of 2025 (4.25–4.50%) leaves ample room for additional easing even after expected 2025 cuts
Six scheduled FOMC meetings (Jan, Mar, May, Jun, Jul, Sep 2026) provide multiple opportunities for a move
sources_consulted: Federal Reserve Summary of Economic Projections (December 2024)
